changes.label: Happy Valley → Sheung Wan by Ding Ding

transportOptions.notes: Budget alternative only if time allows; check the live route/stop and add waiting/walking. Do not depend on a free shuttle for this morning.

details.fareForTwo: MOP50–80 planning estimate for the car

transportOptions.name: Taxi
